events.title: Café Reel From Owner Photos
must_haves: The reel starts with the attached café storefront, retaining its striped awning and outdoor tables.
Both the attached leaf-foam latte and the attached pastry counter are recognisable in later shots.
The opening text reads exactly 'Maple Street Café' and the closing text reads exactly 'Your morning starts here'.
The photos have gentle visible movement and are framed without stretching.
The finished reel is vertical, lasts approximately 9 seconds, and has soft upbeat music with no speech.

answer_sheet.Photos and order: Use all three attached photos. Start with the storefront; the order of the latte and pastries is your call.
answer_sheet.Style and movement: Cosy, warm and inviting, with gentle movement. Transition choices are your call.
answer_sheet.Audio and language: Soft upbeat music, no talking. English text.
